column1: # Quick plan, step 1 of 4 (hours, not days: the typical document only, one resource at a time):
# the typical workload (text, tables and 30-60 pictures, 10-20 MB) under a closed load of pool + 2 clients, memory
# ample (16 GiB), /tmp on the VM disk, tracing off. For each vCPU count, the pool that gives the most throughput.
# N conversions each: step 0 (2026-10-21) found batches of 40 under 2.5 % rsd in throughput and p95 at 1 and
# 4 vCPU, and the first 2·VUs conversions 4-6 % slow; the analysis drops those and the last round, so N = 40 + 3·VUs
# rounded up to whole rounds of the four documents; 15 s cooldown. --reps 1, then rerun the best pool
# and its neighbours (--only) for a second replicate.
